mapper.select: SELECT FROM stage_goal g WHERE g.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stage_goal (subject_id, title, description, start_date, target_date, status, version) VALUES (#{subjectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{targetDate}, #{status}, 0)
